''See also: [[Varic Vallenar Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Varic Vallenar is a highly accomplished human [[Archmage]], professor, and the Captain of the The Zenith Starship{{!}}Zenith Starship known as [[The Last Horizon]]. A former heir to the [[Vallenar Corporation]], he maintains a complicated and often adversarial relationship with his father, [[Benri Vallenar]]. Varic is recognized as a formidable magical genius, possessing an extraordinary capacity for magic that some observers suggest includes multiple distinct styles or even the essence of several individuals within a single body. His magical expertise is particularly noted in the disciplines of sealing, [[binding]], and [[water]] magic. In his role as Captain, Varic directs the crew of [[The Last Horizon]] and is capable of awakening the ship's [[power core]] through his magic. His reputation in the galaxy is multifaceted; he has been celebrated as a hero of the [[Galactic Union]], yet he also faces accusations of aggression and is placed on execution lists by certain factions. Despite his status as a licensed [[Archmage]], he has faced imprisonment and has been described by some as a threat to peace. Varic is characterized by his silver hair and eyes, often wearing a blue hooded mantle, and he possesses the ability to perform advanced feats such as levitation and powerful offensive spells.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Varic is a human with silver hair and three eyes, including dull silver eyes that shine with a cold light. He has been seen wearing a white jumpsuit, an azure [[wizard]]'s mantle, and a blue hood along with a shining holographic The mask{{!}}mask. His physical features also include an [[ocular implant]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Driven by the intention to save the galaxy, Varic works on behalf of the [[Vallenar Corporation]] to prevent the creation of a new King of the Iron Legion{{!}}Iron Legion King. He is a professor and instructor who has also been described as an unwilling collaborator. Despite being Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's best friend from another life, he is a figure who has turned the galaxy against himself.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a [[Sixfold Archmage]] of the [[Cosmic Path]], Varic specializes in [[binding]], sealing, and elemental [[water]] magic. His repertoire includes [[telekinesis]], levitation, the ability to cast [[Absolute Burial]], and summoning rabbits that function as digital avatar war-hounds. He utilizes various tools such as a [[wand]], a staff that spreads life and [[water]], a Lightcaster IV{{!}}Lightcaster, and golden magic circle{{!}}magic circles for locating survivors.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Captain of The Last Horizon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|After winning a The Zenith Starship{{!}}Zenith Starship, Varic Vallenar became the owner of a vessel that [[Omega]] had intended to steal.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c25">''The Captain'', chapter 25</ref> While aboard Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola's ship, the son of [[Benri Vallenar]] was recognized as the [[Captain of The Last Horizon]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c28">''The Captain'', chapter 28</ref> Varic and Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri had previously worked together to demonstrate the capabilities of the [[Mirror of Silence]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c28" /> Mentioned by both [[Horizon]] and Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola, Varic used his magic to help loosen the [[Titan]]'s grip on Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's mind.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c29">''The Captain'', chapter 29</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c33">''The Captain'', chapter 33</ref> Although he is a [[wizard]] whose magic can be crushed by the [[Behemoth]], Varic is an [[Archmage]] who wears a neck [[amulet]] that shields him from plasma bolt{{!}}plasma bolts.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c34">''The Captain'', chapter 34</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c37">''The Captain'', chapter 37</ref> He is capable of summoning [[water]] that resembles lasers from his fingers.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c37" /> Varic possessed black-and-white copies of defensive emplacements.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c43">''The Captain'', chapter 43</ref> As a [[Sixfold Archmage]], he exists in seven versions of himself due to a [[ritual]] involving five previous lives, the life lived before the [[ritual]], and his current one.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c45">''The Captain'', chapter 45</ref> Utilizing a staff that spreads life and [[water]], Varic has used magic borrowed from a [[World Spirit]] and can even create copies of Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c47">''The Captain'', chapter 47</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Knight's mantle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Varic is a hooded figure characterized by silver eyes and an azure [[wizard]]'s mantle used for protection.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c6">''The Knight'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c16">''The Knight'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c29">''The Knight'', chapter 29</ref> Utilizing a [[wand]] and incantations, he can cast golden magic circle{{!}}magic circles that reveal the location of survivors within a colony section.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c6" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c41">''The Knight'', chapter 41</ref> He is addressed as Captain Vallenar by the narrator and is known to [[Doctor Cryce]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c9">''The Knight'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c13">''The Knight'', chapter 13</ref> Varic possesses an [[ocular implant]] and has three eyes in total.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c29" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c41" /> A best friend to Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion from a previous life, Varic sent footage of Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's combat into the galaxy.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44">''The Knight'', chapter 44</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Captain of the galaxy}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Varic Vallenar is an [[Archmage]] specializing in sealing and [[binding]] who serves as a Captain.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c1">''The Pilot'', chapter 1</ref> Having turned the galaxy against himself, he is recognized as Captain Vallenar by the Vice Chief of Planetary Security{{!}}Vice Chief.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c2">''The Pilot'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4">''The Pilot'', chapter 4</ref> After attempting to track Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri to Fathom, he provides lessons and once tried to use a spell to duplicate Aila Escalon{{!}}Aila's [[combat armor]] and gun.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c5">''The Pilot'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c6">''The Pilot'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> Despite being forcibly delayed, the master of the [[Mirror of Silence]] may be unwilling to cooperate.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c18">''The Pilot'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c22">''The Pilot'', chapter 22</ref> As the [[Captain of The Last Horizon]], Vallenar wears a mantle, an [[amulet]], and carries a Lightcaster IV{{!}}Lightcaster.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24">''The Pilot'', chapter 24</ref> [[Union]] representatives decried his actions, and [[Director Porellus]] addresses him as [[Professor]] Vallenar, noting that [[sealing magic]] is his specialty.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26">''The Pilot'', chapter 26</ref> Varic is a person who can appear in homes without warning and has ordered attacks on the [[Zenith Blade]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c27">''The Pilot'', chapter 27</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29">''The Pilot'', chapter 29</ref> He is associated with the Eye of God{{!}}God's Eye [[ritual]] and has spoken about [[Solstice]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref> Following public revelations, his students had their security status flagged.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c34">''The Pilot'', chapter 34</ref> Varic possesses silver eyes that shine with a cold light.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c43">''The Pilot'', chapter 43</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Memories,” Varic said, and his voice was dry. “The magic came with memories.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Yeah. Apparently the Aether thought I needed to live six lives.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“I’m going to save the galaxy, but I’ll probably just die trying.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Varic Vallenar, Union-certified Archmage.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Is this where you die, Sevenfold Archmage?” Wearily, I corrected her again. “Six. Just six.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c45" />}}
